name: Print Guideline Checker
blurb: wall, bridge and overhang values checked for a print process
intro: Enter the thinnest wall, longest bridge, steepest overhang and the other critical features of a part; each is checked against the typical published limit of the chosen process (Hubs, Formlabs and HP design guides; FDM limits scale with the nozzle). Leave a value empty to skip it.

inputs.label: Smallest detail
inputs.help: Text stroke, emboss or engrave width.

usage: Give the process (fdm, sla, sls, mjf), for fdm the nozzle in mm, and any of: wall, bridge, hole, pin, detail, clearance, escape in mm, overhang in degrees from vertical, and the largest dimension (size) in mm. Empty values are skipped. It returns a pass / at-the-limit / fail table with the guideline for each, the count passed, the expected tolerance, and a warning for each failing value with why it matters. Use it before printing or when designing a part for a given process.
sources: Hubs (Protolabs Network), Key design considerations for 3D printing: FDM and SLS limits and tolerances
Formlabs, Design guide for SLA 3D printing (walls, overhangs, bridges, holes, drain holes)
HP Multi Jet Fusion design guidelines (typical values)
